title: Concept: Hex dependency limited to one environment
description: mix.exs declares a dependency that is compiled only in `dev` or `test`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a dependency that is compiled only in `dev` or `test`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.exs (hex).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a dependency that is compiled only in `dev` or `test`.
